label: Incoming WhatsApp messages to a team group
info: Forwards every private message you receive to a WhatsApp group of your team.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scopes events:read and messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** Replace the group id in the function node with the id of your team group (the id starts with grp_: open the group under **Groups** in the dashboard and copy the grp_ part of the address in your browser, or list your groups with the API). Your number must be a member of that group. Messages from groups are not forwarded, so the flow never loops. One person can have at most 5 messages forwarded an hour and the group gets at most 20 an hour; `@` followed by digits in the text is changed so a stranger cannot ping your team. The first check after you deploy only remembers the newest message, so write to your number from another phone after the deploy and wait up to 30 seconds for the answer. Sending to a group needs the Business plan. Forwards leave one every 10 seconds.
